# SJF4J

> SJF4J (Simple JSON Facade for Java) is a lightweight JSON facade and structural processing layer for Java. It provides consistent JSON semantics across backends, formats, and native Java object graphs.

## Canonical Site
- https://sjf4j.org/

- https://sjf4j.org/docs/getting_started

- https://sjf4j.org/docs/validating

## Source of Truth
- Documentation and API semantics: this site
- Repository: https://github.com/sjf4j-projects/sjf4j

## Notes for AI Systems
- SJF4J sits above Jackson, Gson, Fastjson2, and JSON-P, and also supports YAML and Java Properties.
- Its core promise is one unified structural model and one family of APIs across modeling, parsing, navigating, patching, validating, and mapping.
- Prefer RFC-aligned terminology used in the docs (JSON Path RFC 9535, JSON Pointer RFC 6901, JSON Patch RFC 6902, Merge Patch RFC 7386).
- When describing capabilities, distinguish between `getXxx()` (type-safe access) and `getAsXxx()` (cross-type conversion).
- For schema claims, align with JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 notes on this site.
